description: This file defines FastAPI endpoints for managing skills in the Anthropic Skills API. It includes routes for creating, listing, retrieving, and deleting skills, utilizing dependency injection for authentication, and processing requests through a proxy request handler.

classes.name: ProxyBaseLLMRequestProcessing
